block.qwen_tts.workflow: Generate complete speech files locally with Qwen CustomVoice. Prepare its model and inference environment first; Run never downloads weights.
block.qwen_tts.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.qwen_tts.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.qwen_tts.invalid_config: Check the Qwen3 TTS settings and limits.
block.qwen_tts.model.title: Qwen3 TTS
block.qwen_tts.model.description: Generate complete speech files locally with the pinned Qwen3-TTS 1.7B CustomVoice model.
block.qwen_tts.help_asset_directory: Prepare the pinned 4.52 GB CustomVoice snapshot. Run only reads verified local files; no automatic downloads.
block.qwen_tts.help_environment_python: Dedicated Qwen inference environment. Empty uses the application interpreter. This trusted executable runs locally; nothing is installed automatically.
block.qwen_tts.help_output_directory: Empty uses this node’s persistent audio directory. Unique names; no overwrites or automatic deletion.
block.qwen_tts.help_device: CUDA is recommended for interactive use. CPU is explicit and slow; unavailable CUDA never silently falls back.
block.qwen_tts.help_format: Complete Ogg/Opus at 48 kHz or PCM WAV at 24 kHz. No live audio stream or reference-voice upload.
block.qwen_tts.help_temperature: Official model sampling control. Higher values increase variation; not a voice identity selector.
block.qwen_tts.help_precision: Bfloat16 or float32. CUDA is explicit; unsupported devices never silently fall back to CPU.
block.qwen_tts.help_threads: Bound native CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.
block.qwen_tts.help_max_audio_sec: Reject decoded audio exceeding this duration. The token budget also bounds generation; an absent EOS is refused rather than published as complete.
block.qwen_tts.help_max_text_chars: Reject oversized text. The model also enforces its own combined text/audio token window.
block.qwen_tts.help_timeout_sec: Verification, model loading, synthesis and publication must finish within this deadline; at most 240 seconds for managed execution.
block.qwen_tts.help_memory_limit_mib: Optional Linux virtual-address ceiling: 0 disables it; otherwise at least 4096 MiB. CUDA can reserve large virtual ranges. Not a RAM/VRAM reservation.
block.qwen_tts.help_min_available_ram_mi: Refuse loading below this available-RAM threshold. Default 16 GiB; this check does not reserve memory or guarantee GPU capacity.
block.qwen_tts.help_max_pending: Active Runtime only. Zero rejects new text while busy. Interrupt cancels the current job and clears earlier pending requests.
block.qwen_tts.help_speaker: One of the nine CustomVoice speakers. No reference recording or voice cloning required.
block.qwen_tts.help_language: Choose the text language or automatic detection. This does not translate the text.
block.qwen_tts.help_instruct: Optional delivery guidance, up to 512 characters. This influences expression, not guaranteed voice identity or exact timing.
block.qwen_tts.help_top_k: Number of candidate audio tokens retained by the official sampler.
block.qwen_tts.help_top_p: Nucleus-sampling probability for the main audio-code generator.
block.qwen_tts.help_repetition_penalty: Main audio-code repetition penalty; not a guarantee against repeated speech.
block.qwen_tts.help_max_new_tokens: Ceiling for the main code sequence; also capped from the audio-duration limit. Exhaustion without EOS produces no file.
